plugins.name: meta
plugins.description: How to build a great skills marketplace and its plugins (plugin-dev): repo layout, the Claude + Codex dual-manifest packaging, version discipline, and what makes a plugin/skill worth installing. The same SKILL.md files back the Claude Code plugin.

plugins.name: home-it
plugins.description: Home IT skills. check-network diagnoses home-network speed and DNS failures: compare system / router / public resolvers, inspect negative caches / upstreams / filters, measure throughput / latency / loss / Wi-Fi signal, localize the failing layer, inspect the router UI, and verify one fix at a time. The same SKILL.md files back the Claude Code plugin.

plugins.name: research
plugins.description: Research skills: run a multi-vendor research council with a verified brief (deep-research), read one X post with its thread and links (read-twitter), reach docs, code and repositories a plain fetch can't see (fetch-web-sources), extract what a video says and shows (watch-video), and check which saved links still work (link-rot-checker).
